verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh documents its own Batch Processing API for high-volume processing. It also offers asynchronous screening suited to high-volume scenarios, so a first-party bulk mechanism exists. The evidence is a single brief mention, though, with no detail on which operations can be batched. missing for 10: documentation of the batch API's scope (bulk customer creation/screening, bulk case or alert decisions), batch size limits and job status/result retrieval, any bulk actions in the web app, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
